text:
Mike B.: kicking off netops for the new 'satellite-usw3' region — need cloud account + project created, VPC scaffold, and a quick validation runbook. target: finish handoff tomorrow morning. who can own?
Amanda S.: I can own the account/project creation. quick Q: do we want a single /16 for the region or split into two /18s for infra vs workloads?
Cheng H.: prefer split /18s. infra (control plane, shared services) should be isolated. avoids accidental overlap with customer CIDRs later.
Lia T.: Terraform modules are ready but need vars for AZ mapping and nat gw counts. I'll prepare a varfile. also need the service account + IAM roles for infra automation.
Diego R.: networking note: core VPC peering (central services) needs route priority and shared GW for S3 endpoints — confirm if we use VPC peering or PrivateLink for central logs.
Mike B.: @diego let's aim for PrivateLink for S3 and Cloud Monitoring to avoid route table explosion. peering only for internal APIs where latency matters.
Amanda S.: created project: projects/satellite-usw3-001. billing account linked. added team tags: cost-center:redwood-infra, env:staging.
OpsBot: New ticket created — NETOPS-4721: satellite-usw3 project provisioning (assignee: Amanda S.).
Lia T.: varfile draft attached (paste):
```
region = "us-west-3"
cidr_infra = "10.40.0.0/18"
cidr_workloads = "10.40.64.0/18"
azs = ["usw3-1","usw3-2","usw3-3"]
nat_gw_per_az = 1
```
Cheng H.: GPU quota check — requested quota increase for A10G and A100 in region. support ticket #INC-9982 filed. if quota not approved we'll fallback to smaller instance types for bootstrap.
Diego R.: routing plan: each workload subnet gets a NAT-managed egress; infra subnet uses explicit route to PrivateLink endpoints. add security group rule template: allow 10250/tcp from control-plane CIDR for kubelets.
Amanda S.: IAM roles created: infra-deploy-sa (compute.admin, storage.admin, iam.serviceAccountUser), infra-network-sa (compute.networkAdmin). keys rotated via KMS, placed into secrets manager.
Mike B.: handoff checklist for validation run (short):
- terraform apply in staging project (confirm plan output)
- verify subnets and route tables (aws vpc describe-subnets)
- smoke GPU node create: terraform module for nodepool (1 x small gpu)
- kubectl: get nodes, ensure kubelet Ready
- push sample inference container, run 1 request, measure latency
- billing alert: create budget threshold at 25% of expected monthly commit
- tagging audit: ensure cost-center and env tags on all resources

Lia T.: i'll run the terraform apply and the smoke node creation. can someone run the kube validation once node is up?
Cheng H.: i can run kube checks and a small perf run. if quota is pending, i'll spin up `g4dn.xlarge` equiv for smoke to validate networking only.
Diego R.: i'll configure PrivateLink endpoints and confirm S3 access from infra subnet (no internet egress). test using `aws s3 ls --endpoint-url https://s3.us-west-3.amazonaws.com` from a bastion.
Amanda S.: done with apply in staging, plan matches. nat gateways and route tables look good.
Mike B.: ok team — aim to finish validation tonight. final handoff message in this thread when all checks pass. :thumbsup:
